title: SIDE B
summary: Three distinct record sleeves become one bold print-led imprint and a usable collection storefront.

base.provenance: Local parent repository, codex/portfolio-design-refinement; not an asserted GitHub base

cover.alt: Three original SIDE B sleeves—orange Night Index, cobalt Soft Static and pale green After Hours—with black vinyl and a yellow campaign poster in a record-shop concept display.
cover.disclosure: Original cover graphics; AI-generated physical concept photography

case.kind: Semantic article fragment to place inside the parent main element

demo.limits: Browser-local bag; no checkout, real inventory, payments, audio or Shopify connection

assets.rule: Copy side-b-* files and the side-b/fonts subfolder with its licences; preserve nested relative paths. Do not copy evidence into deploy assets.

palette.mechanic: Yellow identifies the imprint; orange, cobalt and pale green identify individual releases. Black structures type and actions.

typography.display: Ultra Regular — wide slab; Apache 2.0; self-hosted
typography.body: Chivo variable — utility grotesque; SIL OFL 1.1; self-hosted
typography.fallbacks: Rockwell/Georgia for display; Arial/Helvetica for body

motion: Stillness. Gallery replaces the selected image immediately through native buttons, with matching keyboard/touch/reduced-motion behaviour.

shopify.state: Source only. No upload or live theme verification. Native cart remains owned by the target theme.
shopify.sourceValidation: Local schema, locale, asset and embedded JavaScript checks available. Full Shopify validator blocked by missing bundled @shopify/theme-check-common; no dependencies installed.

evidence.status: Verified for the local HTML scope; Shopify/device/screen-reader boundaries remain unverified

parentOwnership: Final portfolio overview cards, shared navigation/builder integration, combined review, catalog coordination, store access and any publication. Existing Morrow and RIFT files were not changed.
shopifyStatus: Published dedicated Shopify development store. See shopify-stores/stores.json and docs/shopify-migration.md for access and verification.
publicationStatus: Portfolio on Netlify; Shopify demo published. Historical module preview instructions below refer to the retained HTML prototype.
